---
title: "Fetch Data via the Kotlin SDK"
description: "How to read data from the Aptos blockchain using the Kotlin SDK"
sidebar:
  label: "Via the SDK"
---

Kaptos provides dedicated, namespaced services for querying on-chain data from the Aptos blockchain.

## Result-based handling

All SDK operations return an `AptosResult<T>` sealed interface. You can handle the results using `when` expressions or extension functions like `.map()`, `.onSuccess()`, and `.onFailure()`.

```kotlin
when (val result = aptos.ledger.info()) {
  is AptosResult.Success -> println("Version: ${result.value.version}")
  is AptosResult.Failure -> println("Error: ${result.error.message}")
}
```

For more details on error handling, see the [Response Handling](/build/sdks/community-sdks/kotlin-sdk/response-handling) documentation.

## Read ledger data

Use the `ledger` service to query network information or specific blocks:

```kotlin
// Get current ledger state
val state = aptos.ledger.info().getOrNull()!!

// Get a block by height
val block = aptos.ledger.blockAtHeight(1UL).getOrNull()!!
```

## Read account data

Use the `accounts` service to look up account metadata and resources:

```kotlin
val address = AccountAddress.fromString("0x1")
val accountInfo = aptos.accounts.get(address).getOrNull()!!
```

## Read balances

The `accounts` service provides a convenient method to fetch balances for both traditional coins and fungible assets:

```kotlin
// Coin balance
val aptBalance = aptos.accounts.getBalance(
  address,
  AccountAsset.coin("0x1::aptos_coin::AptosCoin"),
).getOrNull()!!

// Fungible asset balance
val faBalance = aptos.accounts.getBalance(
  address,
  AccountAsset.fungibleAsset("0xa"),
).getOrNull()!!

// Or read coin balance via concise view call shorthand
val coinBalance = aptos.views.callOf<AptosCoin>(
  function = "0x1::coin::balance",
  address,
).getOrNull()!!
```

## Read via Move view functions

Use the `views` service to evaluate view functions defined in Move modules. The `callOf` shorthand automatically validates arguments against the on-chain ABI and coerces standard Kotlin types:

```kotlin
// Concise view call without arguments
val result = aptos.views.callOf(
  function = "0x1::chain_id::get",
).getOrNull()!!

// Concise view call with reified type argument and inferred arguments
val balance = aptos.views.callOf<AptosCoin>(
  function = "0x1::coin::balance",
  address,
).getOrNull()!!
```

If you need to pass raw arguments without SDK validation or ABI lookup, use `callRaw`:

```kotlin
val result = aptos.views.callRaw(
  function = "0x1::coin::balance",
  typeArguments = listOf("0x1::aptos_coin::AptosCoin"),
  arguments = listOf(JsonPrimitive("0x1")),
).getOrNull()!!
```
